title: Nadodi Pattukkaran
desc: Sundaram, a musician, travels from one place to another along with his troupe. One day, the troupe drives away a group of robbers who terrorise a village and subsequently, they settle there.

title: Eera Nilam
desc: A woman's sons go to the Kargil war and get martyred. Later, the younger son takes the responsibility of supporting his family.

title: Kanda Naal Mudhal
desc: After quarrelling as children, two young adults discover their path to love.

title: Rasigan
desc: Vijay and Anitha fall head over heels in love with each other, but are are unable to express their feelings. When Anitha's father gets a wind of it, he tries separating the couple.
